  • ''Hail, Lorekeeper Zorik
  • Zorik: I seek those who practice the art of dark magicks. I seek those who call themselves necromancers. Are you a necromancer?
  • say: I am a necromancer
  • Zorik: Excellent. Are you sure enough of your skills to undertake my taksks? If not, get out of my sight, weakling!
  • Say: I will undertake your tasks.
  • Zorik: I thought so. One should never back down from a challenge. Once you have completed them, I will have a cap, a robe, sleeves, wristbands, gloves, leggings and boots to reward you with.
  • Say: What
'''After turn-in:''' Lorekeeper Zorik smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Coldain]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Dain Frostreaver IV]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got worse.
